liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer favored the Sugar Mag to Scarlet to Fire sequence before drums [16]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Black Peter was moving in a way it had not been before [18]
- **When Push Comes To Shove** (1 review): When Push Comes To Shove was not weak; Jerry was psyched to lay it on [22]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy signaled the boys were back; Jerry was great to see again [26]
- **Sunshine Daydream** (1 review): Sunshine Daydream is probably the reviewer's all-time favorite from this run [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-03-22.mtx.peterson.GEMS.123019.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 141 min [1]
- **gd1987-03-22.147624.ultramatrix.sbd.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 18 songs; 141 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd87-03-22.schoeps.weber-small.dnk.3854.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 147 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: Jerry was too quiet until Scarlet Begonias, then he cranked his own volume [21]
- **gd87-03-22.sbd.clugston.9734.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 131 min; rated 4.06/5 by 18 [7]. Said about its sound: Matrix recording is heavy on audience sound, noted as cool for this show [17]

## Around the show

- Parking lot sticker read 'GIVE HIM FIVE - HE'S STILL ALIVE' honoring Jerry's return [16]
- Beautiful weather surrounded the Coliseum; reviewer hitched a ride after their Beetle died [18]
- Jerry wore red and looked good; audience grabbed prime front-row real estate [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-03-22.mtx.peterson.GEMS.123019.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Jamie Waddell and Jim Blackwood; source: SBD/AUD Matrix master tapes recorded by Don Pearson; transferred by Jim Blackwood; mastered by Jamie Waddell at 24/96 src with Weiss Saracon to 16/44.1;… [1]
- **gd1987-03-22.147624.ultramatrix.sbd.miller.flac24**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]. Also: Tape flips patched with FOB Schoeps PCM; Jamie Waddell supplied some masters [2]
- **gd87-03-22.schoeps.weber-small.dnk.3854.sbefail.shnf**: source: FOB Schoeps CMC441 > Oade P.S. > Sony PCMF1 [4]
- **gd87-03-22.sbd.clugston.9734.sbefail.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette (Ultra-Matrix) > Reel to Reel > PCM > CDR [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1987-03-22 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1987-03-22-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [29]
